title: What should we do when parseInt in EditAlertActivity returns null
symptom: A NullPointerException occurs in EditAlertActivity.java line 795 when parseInt returns null and is cast to int, causing a crash in the onTouch listener.
cause: The parseInt call can return null, and the code casts it to int without null check, leading to a NullPointerException.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit that likely added a null check or fallback to default value. The thread suggests using a try-catch or checking for null and using SnoozeActivity.getDefaultSnooze(above) as fallback.
